description: Source code for managing data model entries, including fault handling, object validation, and plugin management in a network device management context.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes the context with entry object, vendor extensions, and memory setup.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_clean
methods.description: Cleans up the context, freeing resources and memory.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_init_sub
methods.description: Initializes a sub-context with specific entry object and vendor extensions.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_clean_sub
methods.description: Cleans up a sub-context, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: get_fault_message
methods.description: Retrieves the fault message string corresponding to a fault code.

methods.name: bbf_fault_map
methods.description: Maps internal fault codes to external fault representations and sets fault messages.

methods.name: bbf_entry_method
methods.description: Handles various entry operations like get, set, add, delete, and operate based on command.

methods.name: bbf_global_init
methods.description: Initializes global plugin system and memory with entry object and vendor extensions.

methods.name: bbf_global_clean
methods.description: Cleans up global plugin system and memory.

methods.name: dm_entry_validate_allowed_objects
methods.description: Validates if a value is among allowed objects (to be removed later).

methods.name: dm_entry_validate_external_linker_allowed_objects
methods.description: Validates if a value is among allowed external linker objects (to be removed later).

methods.name: dm_validate_allowed_objects
methods.description: Validates if a reference's path is among allowed objects.

methods.name: adm_entry_get_reference_param
methods.description: Retrieves a reference parameter value based on context, param, and linker.

methods.name: adm_entry_get_reference_value
methods.description: Retrieves a reference value for a given parameter.

methods.name: adm_entry_get_linker_param
methods.description: Retrieves a linker parameter value (to be removed later).

methods.name: adm_entry_get_linker_value
methods.description: Retrieves a linker value for a given parameter.

methods.name: adm_entry_object_exists
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in the data model.

methods.name: bbf_entry_restart_services
methods.description: Restarts services for changed packages, optionally restarting services.
